# Pose at obs 91:
# obs 90 pose: X = -1.8848, Y = 3.7982, theta = 210 deg

# In obs 91, we have a clear view looking southeast (heading 120 deg):
# Floor lamp 1 on the left, Plant 2 in the foreground center, Sofa 1 in the background!
import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0091.png")

# Lamp base:
# Dark circular base on left
mask_lamp = (img[:,:,0] > 70) & (img[:,:,0] < 120) & (img[:,:,1] > 70) & (img[:,:,1] < 120) & (img[:,:,2] > 70) & (img[:,:,2] < 120)
yl, xl = np.where(mask_lamp[:, 40:100])
xl += 40
print(f"Lamp base in obs 91: x=[{xl.min()}, {xl.max()}], y=[{yl.min()}, {yl.max()}], center_x={xl.mean():.1f}, bottom_y={yl.max()}")

# Plant 2 pot:
mask_pot = (img[:,:,2] > 140) & (img[:,:,1] < 100) & (img[:,:,0] < 60)
yp, xp = np.where(mask_pot[:, 130:200])
xp += 130
print(f"Plant 2 in obs 91: x=[{xp.min()}, {xp.max()}], y=[{yp.min()}, {yp.max()}], center_x={xp.mean():.1f}, bottom_y={yp.max()}")
'
